title: Bank change from the vendor's real domain, signed by someone who left

request.raw_text:
Hi team,

We have moved our banking to ICICI Bank. Please update our account for all future payments:
Account name: Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd
Account no: 5555 6666 7777
IFSC: ICIC0000456

The old HDFC account will be closed at month end.

Bhai please jaldi kar do, boss bahut gussa hai. Aaj hi ho jana chahiye, warna bahut problem ho jayegi. Checking-vecking baad mein kar lena.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Finance Head, Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd
